plainText:
Alyson Leigh Rosenfeld is an American voice actress for the English-language dub of .

==Biography==
Rosenfeld was born on March 21, 1987, in New York City, New York, and became a voice actress as an adult. She started to provide voices for the during the thirteenth season. Her first major roles were the Nurse Joys of the Unova region as well as their . In , she received the role of voicing , 's younger sister and one of . In , she voiced 's classmate , as well as Mallow's Tsareena. Rosenfeld is currently affiliated with A3 Artists Agency.

Rosenfeld is married to James Weaver Clark and currently resides in New York City. On April 28, 2020, Rosenfeld gave birth to a son.
